mapper.sql: cms_topic.status = 1 and cms_topic.user_status = 1 and cms_topic.del_flag = 0 and cms_topic.is_template = 0 and coalesce(cms_topic.club_member_only, 0) = 0 and and (cms_topic.club_id is null or cms_topic.club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club catalog_club where catalog_club.id = cms_topic.club_id and catalog_club.del_flag = 0 ))
mapper.select: select cms_topic.city_code as cityCode, case when count(distinct nullif(trim(catalog_city.club_city), '')) = 1 then min(nullif(trim(catalog_city.club_city), '')) else null end as cityName, count(distinct cms_topic.id) as topicCount, count(distinct case when cms_topic.lifecycle = 3 and cms_topic.sale_end_at is not null and cms_topic.sale_end_at > now() then cms_topic.id end) as onSaleCount, count(distinct case when coalesce(clm.group_eligible, 0) = 1 then cms_topic.id end) as groupEligibleCount, count(distinct case when coalesce(clm.school_eligible, 0) = 1 then cms_topic.id end) as schoolEligibleCount from cms_topic left join (select id, city as club_city from club where del_flag = 0) catalog_city on catalog_city.id = cms_topic.club_id left join content_landing_metadata clm on clm.topic_id = cms_topic.id and clm.status = 1 where group by cms_topic.city_code order by topicCount desc, cms_topic.city_code asc
select count(*) from ( select cms_topic.city_code from cms_topic where group by cms_topic.city_code ) city_rows
select count(*) from cms_topic where cms_topic.city_code = #{cityCode} and
select distinct cms_topic.product_type from cms_topic where cms_topic.product_type is not null and order by cms_topic.product_type asc
select distinct translation.locale from content_landing_translation translation where translation.translation_state = 'APPROVED' order by translation.locale asc
select distinct metadata.source_locale from content_landing_metadata metadata where metadata.status = 1 and metadata.source_locale is not null order by metadata.source_locale asc

select coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(clm.group_eligible, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as groupEligibleCount, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(clm.school_eligible, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as schoolEligibleCount from cms_topic left join content_landing_metadata clm on clm.topic_id = cms_topic.id and clm.status = 1 where

select coalesce(sum(case when cms_topic.self_play = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as selfPlayCount, coalesce(sum(case when cms_topic.club_id is not null and cms_topic.club_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as clubHostedCount from cms_topic where
